item.title: dragonflydb: 1.34.2 -> 1.39.0
item.description:
Fixes CVE-2026-54341 (RESTORE operations may crash the server; affects versions < 1.39, tracked as #535962), and brings the package up to the current release.

The vendored dependency patches are regenerated against the v1.39.0 helio/dragonfly CMake files, which changed a large number of third-party declarations:

  • Pin abseil-cpp to 20250512.1, the release helio's in-tree patches target (nixpkgs' abseil-cpp now tracks a newer version the patches no longer apply to), and bump the vendored aws-sdk-cpp and jsoncons pins.
  • hnswlib now comes from dragonfly's fork rather than nixpkgs, matching upstream's switch away from nmslib's hnswlib.
  • Vendor the new snowball stemmer dependency (built in-tree); nixpkgs' libstemmer is an older snowball release.
  • Drop the mimalloc 2.1.6 and jemalloc pins, which helio no longer builds.
  • Disable aws-sdk-cpp's git-dependent submodule-version enforcement, which cannot run in the sandbox (the source is already fetched at the exact tag with submodules).

[!NOTE] I had Claude Opus 4.8 help me with the janitoring of the patches required to make DragonflyDB build under nixpkgs, but they're not meaningfully different from the old versions that I manually created when I last updated the package, just tweaked slightly due to dependency drift. I also had the model serve as a glorified bash script to batch-update all of the hashes for pinned dependencies to the versions appropriate to 1.39.0.

I've built it locally and confirmed that it works using redis-cli, including the new search features added since 1.34.2, and carefully reviewed the full diff for reasonableness.

This is a security update. Fixes:

  • GHSA-xp9w-hhf3-vfxx

Things done

  • Built on platform:
    • [x] x86_64-linux
    • [ ] aarch64-linux
    • [ ] aarch64-darwin
  • Tested, as applicable:
    • [x] NixOS tests in nixos/tests.
    • [x] Package tests at passthru.tests.
    • [ ] Tests in lib/tests or pkgs/test for functions and "core" functionality.
  • [x] Ran nixpkgs-review on this PR. See nixpkgs-review usage.
  • [ ] Tested basic functionality of all binary files, usually in ./result/bin/.
  • Nixpkgs Release Notes
    • [ ] Package update: when the change is major or breaking.
  • NixOS Release Notes
    • [ ] Module addition: when adding a new NixOS module.
    • [ ] Module update: when the change is significant.
  • [ ] Fits CONTRIBUTING.md, pkgs/README.md, maintainers/README.md and other READMEs.
  • [ ] Follows the automation/AI policy.
